title: Minimum Cost To Merge Stones
description: Merge piles of stones into one with minimum cost, where each merge involves k consecutive piles.
pseudocode:
1: let n = stones.length
2: if (n - 1) % (k - 1) !== 0 return -1
3: let dp = new Array(n).fill(0).map(() => new Array(n).fill(0))
4: for len from k to n:
5:   for i from 0 to n - len:
6:     let j = i + len - 1
7:     for m from i to j-1 step k-1:
8:       dp[i][j] = min(dp[i][j], dp[i][m] + dp[m+1][j])
9:     if (len - 1) % (k - 1) == 0: dp[i][j] += sum(stones[i...j])
